About this item

  • Live life ethereally with this thin 18.6 mm and light around 1.3 kg Chromebook, solidly built without moving parts for holding and carrying
  • Watch YouTube on the 14-inch FHD TN 250nits display, or listen to your favorite playlist on frontfacing speakers tuned by Waves Audio
  • WiFi 6 and Bluetooth connectivity as well as 13.5-hour battery life mean you can wander about all day while staying connected and productive
  • Take care of your privacy with camera privacy shutter, mute mic key and Google Security Chip H1
  • Connections for all your needs: USB 3.2 Gen 1, USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 (support data transfer, Power Delivery 3.0 and DisplayPort 1.1a), microSD card reader, audio jack (3.5mm)

The screen quality also gets mixed feedback, with some praising it while others find it poor.

    Amazon Customer
    5 out of 5 stars
    Amazing
    Blown away by this little beast. The Arm processor is absolutely amazing for browsing, youtube, discord, google drive etc. There is no fan, it makes absolutely no noise whatsoever and you can use it on the bed without worrying about blocking the vents. Nvidia Geforce Now gaming on this works amazing so does discord. The battery life when full lasts around 16 hours with 50 percent brightness while browsing, which to me is absolutely insane. I know the reviews on other Chromebooks online with the Kompanio 520 say it can be slow, don't take notice. These reviews are of Chromebooks with 4GB of ram. This model has 8gb ram and it is absolutely amazing at multitasking. I'm fully convinced of arm processors for my secondary on the go machine. What a wonder of a little device.

      Elegant, Portable Chromebook that Delivers Reliable Everyday Performance!
      Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 27 August 2025
      Style Name: MT 4GB 64GB
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

      I've been using the Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 Chromebook (14″ FHD, MediaTek Kompanio 520, 4 GB RAM, 64 GB eMMC) for a few weeks now, and it's been an absolute pleasure. Here's what stands out:

      Sleek and lightweight build: The design strikes the perfect balance between premium feel and portability—light enough to carry all day without fatigue, yet durable enough to withstand daily use.

      Vibrant, responsive display: The 14-inch Full HD screen delivers crisp text and vivid colours. Scrolling and navigating feels smooth thanks to the IPS panel’s clarity.

      Efficient performance with the MediaTek Kompanio 520: The octa-core processor smoothly handles multiple browser tabs, streaming, and light productivity tasks. Chrome OS boots up quickly and stays snappy throughout.

      Connectivity and modern features: With Wi-Fi 6, USB-C, USB-A, and a memory card reader, it covers almost everything you’d need for peripherals, accessories, or expanding storage.

      Great value at around £139: This Chromebook offers solid functionality and elegance at a highly competitive price, making it an outstanding choice for students, casual users, or anyone prioritising portability and simplicity.

      In short, the Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 Chromebook offers exceptional everyday usability in a sleek and affordable package. Highly recommended!

      Feel free to tweak this to better reflect your personal experience or voice—adding mention of battery life, keyboard feel, audio quality, or the apps you use most often could make it even more compelling to potential buyers.
